mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_item_start_helps (user_id, proposal_item_id, execution_item_id, evidence_version, request_kind, request_text, help_json, model) VALUES (#{userId}, #{proposalItemId}, #{executionItemId}, #{evidenceVersion}, #{requestKind}, #{requestText}, #{helpJson}, #{model})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plan_item_start_helps WHERE proposal_item_id = #{proposalItemId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, help_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM plan_item_start_helps WHERE execution_item_id = #{executionItemId} AND proposal_item_id IS NULL AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, help_id DESC LIMIT 1
